outcome: Production success reports now attach to the exact verified commit
owner_impact: Successful Virtual Lab deployments keep the same human-readable success report and GitHub mention, but the report is attached directly to the exact production-verified commit instead of using a permanent policy-like issue as a mailbox.

next.text: The approved notification/workflow refactor is complete once this exact candidate is production green; no further owner action is required.

technical_evidence: The smoke job posts the unchanged success-report body to /commits/${GITHUB_SHA}/comments.
The CI contract test requires the exact-commit comment endpoint and forbids REPORT_ISSUE: '145'.
DEVELOPMENT_WORKFLOW.md is the sole execution-procedure authority and preserves the safe rollback and success-only notification invariants.
Exact-SHA deployment verification, production smoke, liveness, red-repair behavior, terminal-report schema, and green stopping semantics are otherwise unchanged.
